note: Aviation maintenance feedback; includes a conflicting severity pair.

corrections.author: fleet.eng@example.com
corrections.subject: wrong software version
corrections.body: The affected unit ran actuator-controller software B2.3, not B2.5. Aircraft on B2.5 annunciated decay promptly.

corrections.author: maint_reviewer
corrections.subject: duration + blank actions
corrections.body: Ground time was seven hours (05:50 to 12:50), and Corrective Actions is blank.

corrections.author: director.maint@example.com
corrections.subject: severity too low
corrections.body: A hydraulic system decay that grounds an aircraft is Critical, not Routine.

corrections.author: maint_reviewer
corrections.subject: severity assessment
corrections.body: Caught on the ground with no in-flight event, so Major per the matrix, not Critical.

corrections.author: maint_reviewer
corrections.subject: wrong figure
corrections.body: The Timeline figure reference is wrong; it should be the pressure decay plot.
